```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5, dpi = 110,
  fig.align = "center"
)

source("incremental_fetch.R")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(deSolve)
})

# Validation: fail loudly if pipeline output has changed shape
stopifnot(
  is.data.frame(outbreak_df),
  all(c("date", "confirmed", "confirmed_deaths", "recovered") %in% names(outbreak_df)),
  is.data.frame(sir_full),
  all(c("time", "I", "R", "D") %in% names(sir_full)),
  is.data.frame(sir_proj),
  length(predicted_I) == nrow(outbreak_df),
  is.numeric(beta0_est), is.numeric(gamma_est), is.numeric(mu_est),
  is.numeric(k_est), is.numeric(tau_est), is.numeric(R0_est)
)
```

# Overview

Automated daily pipeline for the **Ebola Disease Outbreak Analysis Portal**.
This report shares its dataset, parameter estimates, and performance metrics
with the interactive portal at the repository root.

- Population at risk: 20,000,000 persons
- Data stream: confirmed cases only
- Projection horizon: 14 days
- Train / test split: 80 % / 20 %
- Model: SIRD with time-varying transmission \(\beta(t) = \beta_0 e^{-k(t-\tau)}\)

# 1. Primary Parameters

```{r}
param_tbl <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c(
    "Population at risk (N)",
    "Initial infectious (I0)",
    "Initial transmission (beta0)",
    "Recovery rate (gamma)",
    "Mortality rate (mu)",
    "Intervention decay (k)",
    "Intervention start (tau)",
    "Basic reproduction (R0)"
  ),
  Value = c(
    format(POPULATION_AT_RISK, big.mark = ","),
    format(round(I0_fit), big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.4f /day", beta0_est),
    sprintf("%.4f /day", gamma_est),
    sprintf("%.4f /day", mu_est),
    sprintf("%.4f /day", k_est),
    sprintf("%.1f days", tau_est),
    sprintf("%.3f", R0_est)
  )
)
knitr::kable(param_tbl, caption = "Primary SIRD parameters from NLS fitting")
```

# 2. Confirmed Epidemic Curve

```{r confirmed-curve, fig.height=5}
obs_long <- outbreak_df %>%
  select(date, confirmed, confirmed_deaths, recovered) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "series", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(series = recode(series,
    confirmed        = "Confirmed cases",
    confirmed_deaths = "Confirmed deaths",
    recovered        = "Recovered"
  ))

p1 <- ggplot(obs_long, aes(x = date, y = value, colour = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.15) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Confirmed cases"  = "#e74c3c",
    "Confirmed deaths" = "#7f8c8d",
    "Recovered"        = "#16a085"
  ), name = "Series") +
  labs(x = "Time (Date)", y = "Cumulative count",
       title = "Confirmed cases, deaths and recoveries over time") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(p1)
```

# 3. SIRD Compartments

```{r sir-populations, fig.height=5}
sir_long <- sir_full %>%
  select(time, I, R, D) %>%
  pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "compartment", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(compartment = recode(compartment,
    I = "Infectious (I)",
    R = "Recovered (R)",
    D = "Deaths (D)"
  ))

p2 <- ggplot(sir_long, aes(x = time, y = value, colour = compartment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.15) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Infectious (I)" = "#e74c3c",
    "Recovered (R)"  = "#16a085",
    "Deaths (D)"     = "#7f8c8d"
  ), name = "Compartment") +
  labs(x = "Days since first report", y = "Individuals",
       title = "SIRD COMPARTMENTS",
       subtitle = "N = S = 20,000,000") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

print(p2)
```

# 4. Time-Varying Transmission \(\beta(t)\)

```{r beta-trajectory, fig.height=5}
beta_df <- data.frame(
  time = sir_full$time,
  beta_t = sir_full$beta_t
)

p3 <- ggplot(beta_df, aes(x = time, y = beta_t)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.4, colour = "#c0392b") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = gamma_est + mu_est, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#7f8c8d", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = max(beta_df$time) * 0.1,
           y = gamma_est + mu_est,
           label = "Threshold (gamma + mu)",
           colour = "#7f8c8d", size = 3, vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(x = "Days since first report", y = "beta(t) (/day)",
       title = "Time-varying transmission rate",
       subtitle = sprintf("beta(t) = beta0 * exp(-k * (t - tau)), beta0=%.3f, k=%.4f, tau=%.1f",
                          beta0_est, k_est, tau_est)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p3)
```

# 5. Model Fit vs Observed Cases

```{r fit-vs-observed, fig.height=5}
fit_df <- data.frame(
  date      = outbreak_df$date,
  Observed  = observed_I,
  Predicted = round(predicted_I, 0)
) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "series", values_to = "value")

p4 <- ggplot(fit_df, aes(x = date, y = value, colour = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(data = subset(fit_df, series == "Observed"),
            linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "solid") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Observed"  = "#1f2d3d",
    "Predicted" = "#e74c3c"
  ), name = "Series") +
  labs(x = "Time (Date)", y = "Cumulative confirmed cases",
       title = "Observed vs fitted cumulative cases",
       subtitle = "SIRD with time-varying transmission") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(p4)
```

# 6. Predictive Model with Train / Test Windows

```{r predictive, fig.height=6}
full_days <- nrow(outbreak_df) - 1

pred_df <- data.frame(
  day       = seq(0, full_days + PROJECTION_DAYS),
  observed  = c(observed_I, rep(NA, PROJECTION_DAYS)),
  fitted    = c(predicted_I, sir_proj$I[-1] + sir_proj$R[-1] + sir_proj$D[-1])
)

zone_df <- data.frame(
  xmin = c(-Inf,                    train_n - 1,          full_days),
  xmax = c(train_n - 1,             full_days,            full_days + PROJECTION_DAYS),
  fill = c("#27ae60",               "#e67e22",            "#ffffff"),
  zone = factor(c("Training window", "Test window",       "Future prediction"),
                levels = c("Training window", "Test window", "Future prediction"))
)

p5 <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = zone_df,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = zone),
            alpha = 0.16, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df,
            aes(x = day, y = observed),
            colour = "#1f2d3d", linewidth = 1.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df,
            aes(x = day, y = fitted),
            colour = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 1.3,
            linetype = "dashed", na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Training window"   = "#27ae60",
    "Test window"       = "#e67e22",
    "Future prediction" = "#dddddd"
  ), name = "Window") +
  labs(x = "Days since first report", y = "Cumulative confirmed cases",
       title = "Observed vs fitted vs 14-day projection",
       subtitle = "SIRD with intervention-aware transmission") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(p5)
```

# 7. Model Performance

```{r performance}
perf_tbl <- data.frame(
  Window  = c("Train", "Test", "Overall"),
  RMSE    = round(c(train_perf$rmse, test_perf$rmse, overall$rmse), 2),
  MAE     = round(c(train_perf$mae,  test_perf$mae,  overall$mae),  2),
  R2      = round(c(train_perf$r2,   test_perf$r2,   overall$r2),   3)
)
knitr::kable(perf_tbl, caption = "SIRD model performance metrics")
```

# 8. 14-Day Projection Table

```{r projection-table}
proj_tbl <- as.data.frame(sir_proj) %>%
  mutate(date = max(outbreak_df$date) + time - full_days) %>%
  select(date, time, S, I, R, D, beta_t)

knitr::kable(head(proj_tbl, 15),
             caption = "SIRD compartments over the next two weeks")
```
